SparkR / SPARKR-244
[SparkR-SQL] unit test failure after integration of PR that implements subtract() and subtractByKey()
Issue Type: Bug
Assignee: Sun Rui
Created: 08/Apr/15 4:49 AM
Priority: Major
Reporter: Sun Rui

Test failure log:

1. Error: subtract() on RDDs ---------------------------------------------------
error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'collect':
unable to find an inherited method for function ‘subtract’ for signature ‘"RDD", "RDD"’
Calls: subtract -> <Anonymous>
1: withCallingHandlers(eval(code, new_test_environment), error = capture_calls)
2: eval(code, new_test_environment)
3: eval(expr, envir, enclos)
4: collect(subtract(rdd1, rdd1)) at test_rdd.R:459
5: .handleSimpleError(function (e)

Unknown macro: { e$calls <- head(sys.calls()[-seq_len(frame + 7)], -2) signalCondition(e) }

, "error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'collect': Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable) : \n unable to find an inherited method for function ‘subtract’ for signature ‘\"RDD\", \"RDD\"’\nCalls: subtract -> <Anonymous>\n",
quote(collect(subtract(rdd1, rdd1))))
Error: Test failures
In addition: Warning message:
closing unused connection 5 (raw(0))
Execution halted
Had test failures; see logs.
The command "./run-tests.sh" exited with 255.

The cause is due to generic function name conflict. DF has a method called subtract, while RDD also has this method.

According to https://spark.apache.org/docs/1.3.0/api/scala/index.html#org.apache.spark.sql.DataFrame, DF has a method called except instead of subtract (which has the same functionality).

So it seems that changing DF.subtract to DF.except will solve this conflict. Does anyone know the reason why changing except to subtract before?

Re: [SparkR-SQL] unit test failure after integration of PR that implements subtract() and subtractByKey()

Compared with DF.subtract, RDD.subtract has one more optional parameter numPartitions. Seems it is possible for them to share a single generic function. However, before we going this direction, I want to know the reason why we introduced DF.subtract instead of DF.except. If there is no strong reason, keeping SparkR DF API consistent with DF scala API is of more importance, I think.

parts: Zongheng Yang commented on SPARKR-244
Re: [SparkR-SQL] unit test failure after integration of PR that implements subtract() and subtractByKey()

I think it's simply because 'except' is a reserved word in Python, so PySpark opted to use 'subtract' [1]. The SparkR API was probably implemented w.r.t. PySpark.

We should just go ahead and name it as 'except' in SparkR.

[1] https://github.com/apache/spark/blob/master/python/pyspark/sql/dataframe.py#L677
